about: Plan 8.3: the performance gate (npm run perf:gate), Playwright + the browser's own PerformanceObserver metrics, measured like Lighthouse (5 runs, median run). Levels: error fails the gate, warn is reported. W10.E9: every limit is the plan's target as an error, on desktop and on the phone; `target` repeats it for the report. The gate stays red until the work that meets the targets lands (W10.E1-E3, W10.E19); src/__tests__/perfGate.test.ts fails when a limit is looser than the plan. INP is measured in e2e/inp-budget.spec.ts, not here.
